ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISCHANGED(Validity_Period_Days__c), OR( Validity_Period_Days__c < 1, Validity_Period_Days__c > 30 ), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Quote.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Validity Period should be between 1 to 30 days
